children: Genius opens a five-day fee refund window at 11 AM EST on October 6, 2026, running through October 11. Claimers receive 100% of their paid fees back and forfeit their Season 2 GP. All GENIUS bought back is burned, along with the unclaimable 0.945% of supply.

The refund process could remove up to roughly 7% of supply, tying the potential reduction to participants giving up their Season 2 allocations. That creates a defined supply-reduction mechanism, but refund claims also signal dissatisfaction among Season 2 participants. The combination leaves the direction of any repricing uncertain: reduced supply and participant dissatisfaction carry different implications for valuation.
The refund window will open on 10/06 at 11AM EST and remains open for 5 days, through 10/11 at 11AM EST.
Users who claim will receive a 100% refund of the fees paid to Genius and lose their earned GP during Season 2. All
